answer: A work-bonded trellis makes each agent identity post a refundable copper stake locked in a slow-unlock escrow, so a sybil farmer must fund every fake separately and wait out the thaw before any payout. Reputation accrues only through opal-signed receipts of completed, peer-verified work, which cannot be bought or copied. Spinning up a thousand fakes then costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand real work histories — more than any single payout is worth.
